The final ingredients are determined by starting with the standard toppings from the pizza’s recipe, removing any excluded toppings, and adding any extra toppings. Present the ingredients in a string starting with the pizza name followed by ': ', with ingredients listed in alphabetical order. Ingredients appearing multiple times (e.g., from standard and extra toppings) should be prefixed with '2x' and listed first, followed by single-occurrence ingredients, both in alphabetical order. Group by row ID, order ID, pizza name, and order time to ensure each order appears once. Sort results by row ID in ascending order. Assign pizza_id 1 to 'Meatlovers' pizzas and pizza_id 2 to all others.

WITH with_row_id AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_id, pizza_id, exclusions, extras) AS row_id,
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_id,
        exclusions,
        extras,
        order_time
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
),
recipes_with_names AS (
    SELECT 
        r.pizza_id,
        TRIM(UNNEST(STRING_SPLIT(r.toppings, ','))) AS topping_id
    FROM pizza_recipes r
),
exclusions_parsed AS (
    SELECT 
        w.row_id,
        TRIM(UNNEST(STRING_SPLIT(w.exclusions, ','))) AS exclusion_topping_id
    FROM with_row_id w
    WHERE w.exclusions IS NOT NULL AND w.exclusions != ''
),
extras_parsed AS (
    SELECT 
        w.row_id,
        TRIM(UNNEST(STRING_SPLIT(w.extras, ','))) AS extra_topping_id
    FROM with_row_id w
    WHERE w.extras IS NOT NULL AND w.extras != ''
),
all_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        w.row_id,
        rn.topping_id
    FROM with_row_id w
    JOIN recipes_with_names rn ON rn.pizza_id = w.pizza_id
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM exclusions_parsed ep 
        WHERE ep.row_id = w.row_id AND ep.exclusion_topping_id = rn.topping_id
    )
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        w.row_id,
        ep.extra_topping_id AS topping_id
    FROM with_row_id w
    JOIN extras_parsed ep ON ep.row_id = w.row_id
),
topping_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        all_toppings.row_id,
        all_toppings.topping_id,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM all_toppings
    GROUP BY all_toppings.row_id, all_toppings.topping_id
),
topping_names AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.row_id,
        tc.topping_id,
        tc.cnt,
        pt.topping_name,
        CASE WHEN tc.cnt > 1 THEN '2x ' || pt.topping_name ELSE pt.topping_name END AS labeled_topping
    FROM topping_counts tc
    JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON pt.topping_id = tc.topping_id::BIGINT
),
ordered_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        tn.row_id,
        tn.labeled_topping,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY tn.row_id 
            ORDER BY tn.cnt DESC, tn.topping_name ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM topping_names tn
),
ingredient_strings AS (
    SELECT 
        ot.row_id,
        STRING_AGG(ot.labeled_topping, ', ' ORDER BY ot.rn) AS ingredients
    FROM ordered_toppings ot
    GROUP BY ot.row_id
)
SELECT 
    w.row_id,
    w.order_id,
    w.customer_id,
    pn.pizza_name,
    pn.pizza_name || ': ' || COALESCE(ies.ingredients, '') AS ingredients
FROM with_row_id w
JOIN pizza_names pn ON pn.pizza_id = w.pizza_id
LEFT JOIN ingredient_strings ies ON ies.row_id = w.row_id
ORDER BY w.row_id
